boxery — remote desktop VMs for coding agents

Usage:
  boxery [--host NAME] COMMAND [ARGS...]

Getting started:
  setup user@host|local                 Configure a VM host (local = this machine), register your ssh key
  help [--all | COMMAND]                Show help for boxery, a command or a family action

VMs:
  ls                                    List VMs: every host's, a section each (--host NAME: one)
  new NAME                              Create a VM
  start NAME                            Start a stopped VM (pins its ssh host key where it can)
  stop NAME                             Stop a VM
  rm NAME                               Destroy a VM and its snapshots (revokes its LLM token)
  resize NAME                           Change a VM's size (restarts it if running; disk only grows)
  fork SRC DST...                       Copy a VM (running or not) into new VMs, ~10 s
  patch NAME|--all                      Update a VM's guest software to the host's image layers

Work in a VM:
  ssh NAME[@HOST] [CMD...]              Shell into a VM (also: ssh NAME.boxery)
  run NAME CMD [ARG...]                 Run a command in ~/project, args as given (like docker exec)
  cp FROM TO                            Copy files and directories to, from and between VMs
  sync NAME                             Push a local git checkout into a VM, so its tree matches exactly
  desktop NAME                          Open a VM's desktop in your browser (noVNC over ssh)
  forward NAME PORT [LOCAL]             Forward a VM port to localhost
  attach NAME [AGENT]                   Attach to an agent in a persistent tmux session (= agent attach)
  prompt NAME "TASK"                    Start a headless pi task as a background job (= agent prompt)

Command families (boxery FAMILY --help):
  host add|ls|show|use|rm|…             Named hosts, and maintenance of the selected host
  snapshot create|ls|restore|rm|images  Saved VM disk states: create, restore, list, delete
  agent attach|prompt|ls                Persistent coding-agent sessions in a VM
  job ls|logs|wait|kill                 Background jobs in a VM (run --bg starts one)
  access grant|revoke|ls|apply          What a VM may use from this machine (grants)
  lease acquire|renew|release|ls        Borrow a VM from the shared pool
  pool add|rm|ls                        Manage the shared pool of leasable VMs (admin)
  runners once|status|...               GitHub Actions runners on pool VMs

boxery host — named hosts, and maintenance of the selected host:
  host add NAME DEST                    Register DEST (user@host or local) as NAME
  host ls                               List hosts: where each runs and its backend
  host show NAME                        Print a host's profile directory
  host use NAME                         Make NAME the default host
  host rm NAME                          Forget a host (its VMs and profile data stay)
  host build-base                       Build the host's desktop base image (one time, ~3 min)
  host upgrade                          Update boxery on the host and restart its services
  host proxy-log [N]                    Recent LLM and edge (http: grant) requests on the host
  host backend                          The host's VM backend (recorded for host ls)
  host backends                         Backend support and capabilities on every host
  host capabilities                     Every host's platform and capabilities (--host NAME: one)

boxery snapshot — saved VM disk states: create, restore, list, delete:
  snapshot create NAME [SNAP]           Snapshot a VM's disk (Lima restarts a running VM)
  snapshot ls NAME                      List a VM's snapshots
  snapshot restore NAME SNAP            Restore a VM to a snapshot (keeps its name, address and token)
  snapshot rm NAME SNAP                 Delete a snapshot
  snapshot images                       Snapshots on every host, with HOST column (--host NAME: one)

boxery agent — persistent coding-agent sessions in a VM:
  agent attach NAME [AGENT]             Attach to an agent in a persistent tmux session
  agent prompt NAME "TASK"              Start a headless pi task as a background job
  agent ls NAME                         List a VM's tmux sessions

boxery job — background jobs in a VM (run --bg starts one):
  job ls NAME                           List background jobs (run --bg starts one)
  job logs NAME JOB                     Show a job's output (the last 200 lines)
  job wait NAME JOB                     Wait for a job; exits with its exit code
  job kill NAME JOB                     Stop a job: SIGTERM its process group, then SIGKILL

boxery access — what a VM may use from this machine (grants):
  access grant NAME SPEC...             Give a VM access to something on this machine (asks first)
  access revoke NAME SPEC...|all        Take access away (pushed values are deleted from the VM)
  access ls NAME                        Show a VM's grant kinds and settings (read-only)
  access apply NAME                     Push a VM's grants to it again

boxery lease — borrow a VM from the shared pool:
  lease acquire                         Lease a VM from the shared pool (prints NAME LEASE_ID)
  lease renew NAME                      Extend your lease
  lease release NAME                    Give a leased VM back (it is reset to its clean snapshot)
  lease ls                              Your leases on every host (--host NAME: one)

More:
  pin NAME                              Re-pin a VM's ssh host key (VMs made before keys were pinned)
  shapes                                VM sizes on every host (* = default; --host NAME: one)
  version                               Controller and every host's version; warns per host

Older spellings (still work; the same commands as the family actions):
  build-base                            Build the host's desktop base image (one time, ~3 min) (= host build-base)
  snap NAME [SNAP]                      Snapshot a VM's disk (Lima restarts a running VM) (= snapshot create)
  snaps NAME                            List a VM's snapshots (= snapshot ls)
  revert NAME SNAP                      Restore a VM to a snapshot (keeps its name, address and token) (= snapshot restore)
  snap-rm NAME SNAP                     Delete a snapshot (= snapshot rm)
  images                                Snapshots on every host, with HOST column (--host NAME: one) (= snapshot images)
  sessions NAME                         List a VM's tmux sessions (= agent ls)
  jobs NAME                             List background jobs (run --bg starts one) (= job ls)
  logs NAME JOB                         Show a job's output (the last 200 lines) (= job logs)
  wait NAME JOB                         Wait for a job; exits with its exit code (= job wait)
  kill NAME JOB                         Stop a job: SIGTERM its process group, then SIGKILL (= job kill)
  grant NAME SPEC...                    Give a VM access to something on this machine (asks first) (= access grant)
  revoke NAME SPEC...|all               Take access away (pushed values are deleted from the VM) (= access revoke)
  grants NAME [apply]                   Show a VM's grants, or push them again (apply) (= access ls | access apply)
  agent-forward NAME on|off             Same as access grant|revoke NAME ssh-agent
  acquire                               Lease a VM from the shared pool (prints NAME LEASE_ID) (= lease acquire)
  renew NAME                            Extend your lease (= lease renew)
  release NAME                          Give a leased VM back (it is reset to its clean snapshot) (= lease release)
  leases                                Your leases on every host (--host NAME: one) (= lease ls)
  upgrade-host                          Update boxery on the host and restart its services (= host upgrade)
  backends                              Backend support and capabilities on every host (= host backends)
  capabilities                          Every host's platform and capabilities (--host NAME: one) (= host capabilities)
  backend                               The host's VM backend (recorded for host ls) (= host backend)
  proxy-log [N]                         Recent LLM and edge (http: grant) requests on the host (= host proxy-log)

Options:
  --host NAME                           Run COMMAND on a host other than the default (boxery host use)
  --json                                JSON output on listings (fields: docs/cli.md#json-output)
  -h, --help                            Show help; boxery COMMAND --help shows a command's
  help --all                            Every command, every family action and every older spelling

Docs: https://github.com/modem-dev/boxery/blob/master/docs/cli.md
Agents: prefer the vm_* tools (boxery-mcp or the pi extension): https://github.com/modem-dev/boxery/blob/master/docs/mcp.md
